content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 4.2 (¶p0026) imposes a Customer-payable liquidated Termination Payment — half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, paid in eight quarterly instalments — with no ceiling, which fails the LD fallback. Because full deletion would require collateral rewrites of 4.2(b)–(c) and the Section 4 heading, I took the fallback target and made a single surgical replacement capping the payment at the Section 3.1 fees for the three months preceding the Termination Date and confirming it is the only early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount we owe. The retained zero-floor and instalment mechanics stay intact and run in our favour.
